title: Grand Opening of CurtainCall Theater
description: We’re thrilled to announce the grand opening of CurtainCall Theater! Join us for an unforgettable night filled with music, laughter, and magic as we open our doors to all theater lovers.

title: New Show Added: The Phantom Returns
description: Due to popular demand, ‘The Phantom of the Opera’ is returning for a limited engagement this winter season. Tickets are on sale now — reserve your seats before they vanish!

title: Behind the Curtains: Meet Our Cast
description: Join us this weekend for a special meet-and-greet event with our talented cast members. Get insights into their creative process and behind-the-scenes stories from the stage.

title: Discount Week: Celebrate the Arts!
description: All shows will feature a 20% discount during our Arts Celebration Week! Support your local theater and enjoy an amazing performance at a special price.

title: Upcoming Premiere: Chicago
description: The jazz is hot and the crime is cold — ‘Chicago’ is coming to CurtainCall this November! Experience one of Broadway’s most iconic musicals live.

title: Holiday Gala Night Announced
description: Celebrate the holiday season in style with our annual Gala Night! Expect a glamorous evening with performances, music, and exclusive surprises.

title: Now Hiring: Backstage Crew
description: We’re expanding our family! If you have a passion for theater production, lighting, or costume design, apply now to join our backstage team.

title: Season Pass Now Available
description: Introducing CurtainCall Season Pass! Enjoy unlimited access to all major shows and exclusive member perks for the entire year of 2026.
